_comment: DA-004 visual-regression exceptions. Surfaces that intentionally differ between the website and the desktop app, so the screenshot diff does not flag them. An UNDOCUMENTED difference must fail the build; every entry here needs a reason. Desktop-only surfaces must still COMPOSE the canonical design tokens (design/tokens.css), never invent values.

exceptions.reason: Desktop has a custom frameless title bar (min/max/close via win:* IPC); the website runs in the browser's own chrome. No web counterpart to diff against.
Desktop shows a warp-speed boot animation (renderer/app.js bootWarp) gated by prefers-reduced-motion; the website has no boot splash.
Desktop embeds xterm.js live terminals (pty:*); the website cannot run a shell, so there is no shared render.
Desktop renders a live QEMU framebuffer (vm:screendump); web has no VM console.
Desktop uses platform context menus and an app menu bar; browser context menus differ by platform.
Desktop embeds a CodeMirror IDE surface not present on the web console.
